communication_goal: 根据重复逻辑与维护成本判断是否值得重构。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left of a small table and points toward one large blank architecture diagram sheet mounted upright at center. The sheet has only three simple unlabeled rectangular boxes connected by plain lines, no letters or numbers. Its complete border is unobstructed. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. No computer screens or extra papers.

coverage_review.scope: V020 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，恰好一个成年火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图文字。中央架构示意板完整可见，只有无标签矩形和连接线；其余三个抽象词仅由对白教学。
